entities.name: Hastric
entities.description: A scout and adventurer from Thune on Shandalar, famous for discovering and describing the Shandalaran slivers.

entities.name: Shandalar
entities.description: The plane where Hastric lived and the slivers are found.

entities.name: Skep
entities.description: An area near the Eastern Sea that was home to the slivers of Shandalar.

entities.name: Eastern Sea
entities.description: A sea on Shandalar near the Skep.

entities.name: Slivers
entities.description: Shape-changing creatures living in the caves of the Skep, led by larger sliver leaders.

entities.name: Yisan
entities.description: An investigator who, with Jalira, followed Hastric's warning to the Skep and was transformed into a sliver.

entities.name: Jalira
entities.description: An investigator who, with Yisan, followed Hastric's warning to the Skep and was transformed into a sliver.

entities.name: The Hum
entities.description: A muted sound serving as communication between slivers, which Hastric kept hearing after leaving the Skep.

events.summary: While scouting near the Eastern Sea, Hastric is struck by a rockfall and tumbles into the sliver caves of the Skep, where he is transformed into a sliver.
events.quote: Hastric found himself transformed into a sliver himself.

events.summary: Hastric discovers that huge sliver leaders command the others, mimics the slivers to avoid notice, and finds a dragon-sized fossilized sliver and worshipped humanoid slivers.
events.quote: He discovered one fossilized sliver that was the size of a dragon

events.summary: Hastric slowly backs away into a tunnel and finds evidence in a seaside cave that the slivers once had very different shapes.
events.quote: Hastric kept pretending to follow their swaying and writhing motions

events.summary: Pursued by spiny slivers, Hastric changes into an aquatic sliver, escapes through the ocean and reverts to human form.
events.quote: managed to change into an aquatic form of sliver and escape their caves through the ocean itself

events.summary: Hastric travels Shandalar warning of the danger of the slivers; some call him mad while others form their own expeditions.
events.quote: Hastric's new prime motivation was to warn the world

events.summary: Yisan and Jalira investigate the Skep after hearing Hastric and are transformed into slivers by the sliver leaders.
events.quote: themselves transforming into slivers by the power of the sliver leaders

events.summary: Hastric keeps hearing the Hum after leaving, and his name for it changes to the Thrum and then the Call as he descends into madness.

relations.note: discovered and described the slivers in detail
relations.quote: is famous for having discovered and described the Shandalaran slivers in great detail

relations.note: the Skep was home to the slivers
relations.quote: which was home to the slivers of Shandalar
One such expedition was performed by Yisan and Jalira
